rules.key: 0-1 Mechanicus Archmagos
rules.text: 0-1 Mechanicus Archmagos

rules.key: worth 1,000 points or more, a Mechanicus Archmagos must be included
rules.text: If the fleet is worth 1,000 points or more, a Mechanicus Archmagos must be included to lead it.
rules.why: Note: in this list the wording is 'or more', not 'over'. So the limit is from 1 000 points upwards, unlike the Imperial lists' 'over 750'.

rules.key: An Archmagos Veneratus must be embarked on an Ark Mechanicus
rules.text: An Archmagos Veneratus must be embarked on an Ark Mechanicus if one is included in the fleet.
rules.why: The placement is done at the table. 'Ark Mechanicus' means the Omnissiah's Victory (p. 126).

rules.key: Mechanicus Archmagos can elect up to any one desired item from the Adeptus Mechanicus refit table
rules.text: A Mechanicus Archmagos can elect up to any one desired item from the Adeptus Mechanicus refit table for their own ship as part of their point cost, in addition to (and before) the refit the ship rolls for normally.
rules.why: The refit is chosen from the Mechanicus Gifts table, which the app does not model as a choice.

rules.key: You may include 1 battleship for every three cruisers in the fleet
rules.text: You may include 1 battleship for every three cruisers in the fleet.

rules.key: Omnissiah’s Victory may not take any Mechanicus Gifts refits
rules.text: The Omnissiah's Victory may not take any Mechanicus Gifts refits, as its Mechanicus Gifts are already included in its point cost and special rules.
rules.why: The Gifts table is not modelled as a choice, so the exception does not need enforcing.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13), taken from both the Imperial Navy and Space Marines fleet lists for the point costs listed below but otherwise unmodified from their normal profiles.

rules.key: Attack carriers may use any combination of Fury interceptors and Starhawk bombers
rules.text: Attack carriers may use any combination of Fury interceptors and Starhawk bombers. They may not use assault boats, even if their Imperial Navy counterparts may have access to this type of ordnance (such as Emperor battleships).
rules.why: An ordnance choice during the game. An important exception: the AdMech Emperor does NOT get assault boats, although the Imperial Emperor does.

rules.key: may also take torpedo bombers for +10 points per launch bay
rules.text: Mechanicus vessels equipped with launch bays may also take torpedo bombers for +10 points per launch bay.
rules.why: A priced option; the row 'Torpedo bombers 10 pts' can be chosen.

rules.key: The Adeptus Mechanicus have a starting attack or initiative rating of 2
rules.text: ATTACK RATING The Adeptus Mechanicus have a starting attack or initiative rating of 2.

rules.key: To determine base leadership for a given vessel, roll a D6
rules.text: To determine base leadership for a given vessel, roll a D6 against the following table: D6 ROLL LEADERSHIP 1 Ld 7 2-3 Ld 8 4-6 Ld 9
rules.why: The leadership is rolled at the start of the game. AdMech has its own table, different from the Imperial Navy's.

rules.key: This option cannot be used if the vessel embarks a Mechanicus Archmagos
rules.text: Any vessel that rolls a 6 when determining base leadership may select any one desired refit from the Mechanicus Gifts table instead of rolling for it randomly (this does not mean you get an extra one!). This option cannot be used if the vessel embarks a Mechanicus Archmagos.

rules.key: The Imperial Power Ram may be taken by any Mechanicus capital ship
rules.text: The Imperial Power Ram may be taken by any Mechanicus capital ship with a 6+ prow for +5 points unless it has a Nova Cannon.
rules.why: A priced option; the row 'Imperial Power Ram 5 pts' can be chosen. The condition of a 6+ prow and no nova cannon is implemented as the row's eligibility condition.

rules.key: The Adeptus Mechanicus does not utilize any battlecruisers in their own fleets
rules.text: To avoid raising the concern of the Imperial Navy, The Adeptus Mechanicus does not utilize any battlecruisers in their own fleets, though they still produce them for the Imperial Navy as required.
rules.why: Explains why the list has no battlecruisers. It limits nothing, because there is no row.

rules.key: Every Mechanicus cruiser (not light cruiser) is equipped with a single 60 cm range dorsal lance battery
rules.text: Every Mechanicus cruiser (not light cruiser) is equipped with a single 60 cm range dorsal lance battery firing left/front/right.
rules.why: The app offers this as the row 'Mechanicus dorsal lance battery 0 pts'.

rules.key: All Mechanicus capital ships add +1 to a given vessel's original turret value
rules.text: All Mechanicus capital ships add +1 to a given vessel's original turret value.
rules.why: The app offers this as the row 'Mechanicus turret refit (+1 turret) 0 pts'.

rules.key: Mechanicus capital ships must also roll a D6 once against the Mechanicus Gifts table
rules.text: Mechanicus capital ships must also roll a D6 once against the Mechanicus Gifts table. These improvements are already included in the point cost assigned in the Adeptus Mechanicus Fleet List.
rules.why: The refit is rolled at the start of the game; the price is already included in the ships' point prices.

rules.key: No more than one reserve vessel can be taken for every three capital ships
rules.text: No more than one reserve vessel can be taken for every three capital ships in the fleet.
rules.why: A reserve rule: the ships come from other lists, which this list does not contain.

rules.key: There are no restrictions on how many reserve Imperial Navy, Space Marine or Rogue Trader escorts
rules.text: There are no restrictions on how many reserve Imperial Navy, Space Marine or Rogue Trader escorts are included in an Adeptus Mechanicus fleet, as long as Xenos vessels and reserve Space Marine vessels are not included in the same fleet.

rules.key: Mechanicus vessels can only earn additional refits from the standard Imperial Navy refit table
rules.text: In the course of a campaign, Mechanicus vessels can only earn additional refits from the standard Imperial Navy refit table or the Space Marines reinforcement table.

extra_entries.name: Nova Cannon instead of prow torpedoes
+1 turret (escort squadron)
extra_entries.why: p.121: escorts do not get +1 turret as included in the price

notes: The Cruisers section has NO count limit. The book gives none (compare the Imperial lists' '0-12 Cruisers'), so the app is right to enforce nothing.
AdMech ships cost more than the same hulls in the Imperial Navy (e.g. Dictator 255 vs 220). The difference is in the book: Mechanicus Gifts and +1 turret are included in the price.

Pages 119-123 are largely tables: Mechanicus Gifts (D6), Quest for Knowledge (D6), the Improvement/Alteration tables and Mechanicus Promotions. They are in-game or campaign rolls and not fleet building, so they are left to the player.
